symptom: Homepage discovery rails could retain another tab's cards, while an exact dated vacation search with the online-booking filter could discard every result and show a supplier error even though the discovery API later returned a valid payload.
expected_behavior: Every selection immediately acknowledges its own state, never displays another selection as current, and a transient supplier or capability delay never turns the complete catalog into a false zero-results page.
environment: Public VII v914 on 2026-11-14 and local source based on 495cde793c3c5488f264fd462b1a4250b12e4ca5.

steps: Open the public homepage and switch holiday, spa and event tabs
Observe the online filter, the empty result set and the availability error
reproduction.evidence: Public UI screenshots, browser observations and repeated direct timings of the exact live-search request.

observations.observation: The exact public live-search request returned HTTP 200 with a valid 61,736-byte result, but the first measured response took 4.802 seconds and repeated responses varied between about 3.14 and 5.59 seconds.
The browser client used a 5-second default deadline and no safe retry for this idempotent dated discovery call.
The dated eligibility predicate removed catalog results while availability was loading, and the online-only predicate depended on the same exact-date response instead of retained capability evidence.
observations.evidence: app/lib/dated-availability-eligibility.ts and app/lib/vacation-online-booking-filter.ts before the repair

observations.observation: The shared homepage rail could retain data without requiring the retained selection key to match the current selection key.
The public route-family audit timed out on /favorites before DOMContentLoaded at 30 seconds; the audit runner has been hardened to record and continue instead of hiding all later results.

The completed second public route-family audit reached all 60 desktop and mobile checks. It exposed an avoidable 404 holiday-match request on an ordinary dated search, stale audit expectations for a guide and contact page, and an intentional not-found console message; the runner expectations and the no-holiday response contract were repaired locally.
observations.evidence: scripts/audit-route-reliability.mjs completed public run on 2026-11-14 and app/api/vii/home-holiday-deals/route.ts

observations.observation: The exact repaired URL was opened in the built-candidate preview on desktop and mobile. It rendered 21 properties and 43 units, visible cards, selected-date availability labels, online-booking links, and the 6-of-21 online-filter summary without the invalid-date or availability-failure state.

hypotheses.mechanism: Cross-selection retained client state was rendered as current data.
hypotheses.result: Confirmed and removed by selection-key ownership.

hypotheses.mechanism: A valid but variable 3-6 second supplier discovery response crossed a 5-second browser deadline; the failure then fed both eligibility and online-only filtering.
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by repeated exact-request timing and source inspection.

hypotheses.mechanism: Fresh cached dated discovery still performed unrelated credential and publication reads before returning the cache hit.
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in the route and shortened with an early validated D1 cache return.

fix.change: Selection-key ownership for retained rail data; a bounded 12-second attempt, one safe retry and 18-second total budget for idempotent dated discovery; stale-last-good cache reuse; early validated D1 cache return; fail-open online capability behavior; catalog cards remain visible while exact availability is pending or temporarily unavailable; a no-holiday date probe returns a normal no-match response instead of 404; neutral truthful error copy.
fix.evidence: 48 focused dated-search, online-booking, holiday and slider tests pass, 32 prior slider/spa tests pass, all 17 regression guards pass, critical public family tests pass 65/65, flexible online tests pass 19/19, focused ESLint reports zero errors, the production build passes, and the exact built candidate renders usable results on desktop and mobile.

regression_checks: Exact selected dates remain part of every request and cache identity
A transient discovery failure cannot empty online-only results when capability evidence exists or the capability service is unavailable
Loading without an exact quote keeps catalog cards visible without claiming availability
Retained rail data is rendered only for the same selection key
Fresh cache hits bypass unrelated supplier-token and publication reads
An ordinary date selection with no matching holiday returns a normal no-match response instead of a 404
A route navigation timeout is recorded and does not abort the rest of the audit
remaining_unknowns: The repaired exact URL has not been verified at its public destination because this turn does not authorize publication
authorization_boundary: Local diagnosis, source repair and verification only; no publication or production mutation.
